tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c cccm , tb_pay_calc_formula_n pcf , tb_pay_calc_formula_n pcfOs -- vanaa 03/11/2025 , tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi1 /* parent payroll item */

AND ppi.payroll_item_id = #{srchPayrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND cccm.code_type_code = 'LGDVHR_PAY_CLASS_TYPE_CODE' AND cccm.common_code = ppi.pay_item_classification_code AND cccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND pcf.payroll_calculation_formula_id(+) = ppi.payroll_calculation_formula_id AND pcfOs.payroll_calculation_formula_id(+) = ppi.PAYROLL_CAL_FORMULA_OS_ID -- vanaa 03/11/2025 AND ppi1.payroll_item_id(+) = ppi.payroll_item_id
AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{effectiveDate}, '/', ''), 'DDMMYYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN ppi.start_yyyymmdd AND ppi.end_yyyymmdd AND cccm.code_type_code = 'LGDVHR_PAY_CLASS_TYPE_CODE' AND cccm.common_code = ppi.pay_item_classification_code AND cccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND pcf.payroll_calculation_formula_id(+) = ppi.payroll_calculation_formula_id AND pcfOs.payroll_calculation_formula_id(+) = ppi.PAYROLL_CAL_FORMULA_OS_ID -- vanaa 03/11/2025 AND ppi1.payroll_item_id(+) = ppi.parent_payroll_item_id AND ppi.payroll_item_name LIKE #{payrollItemName}||'%' AND ppi.inquiry_name LIKE #{inquiryName}||'%' AND ppi.pay_item_classification_code = NVL(#{payItemClassificationCode}, ppi.pay_item_classification_code)

WITH detail_list AS ( /* 삭제 건 제외한 리스트 조회 */ SELECT /* LGVPAY00013.retireveValidatePayrollItemData */ payroll_item_id , payroll_item_name FROM tb_pay_payroll_item_m /* 삭제건이 있는 경우 제외 처리 */ WHERE payroll_item_id NOT IN #{deleted[${idx}].payrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) , rs AS ( SELECT -1 AS payroll_item_id , #{created[${idx}].payrollItemName} AS payroll_item_name FROM dual UNION ALL /* 신규건이 있는 경우 기존데이터와 union하기 위해 union 함 */ SELECT detail_list.payroll_item_id , NVL(update_list.payroll_item_name, detail_list.payroll_item_name) AS payroll_item_name FROM detail_list , ( /* 수정건이 있는 경우 Detail 항목 리스트와 outer join 하여 등록된 최종 Detail 리스트를 조회한다 */ SELECT #{updated[${idx}].payrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS payroll_item_id , #{updated[${idx}].payrollItemName} AS payroll_item_name FROM dual ) update_list WHERE detail_list.payroll_item_id = update_list.payroll_item_id(+) SELECT detail_list.payroll_item_id , detail_list.payroll_item_name FROM detail_list ) SELECT (SELECT DISTINCT listagg(rs.payroll_item_name, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rs.payroll_item_name) OVER (PARTITION BY 1) AS dup_names FROM rs GROUP BY rs.payroll_item_name HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ) AS dup_names /* 중복된 payroll item 항목명 */ ,(SELECT '
'||lslm.label_name||'=' FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.payrollItemName' AND lslm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) AS dup_names_title FROM dual

mapper.insert: INSERT /* LGVPAY00013.insertPayrollItemDetail */ INTO tb_pay_item_detail_n( payroll_item_detail_detail_id /* 급여항목상세내역아이디 */ , payroll_item_id /* 급여항목아이디 */ , additional_input_value /* 추가입력문자값 */ , pay_calc_rslt_detail_type_code /* 급여산출실적상세구분코드 */ , sort_order_no /* 정렬순서번호 */ , creation_date /* 생성일자 */ , creation_user_id /* 생성사용자아이디 */ ) SELECT sq_tb_pay_item_detail_n.nextval /* payroll_item_detail_detail_id => 급여항목상세내역아이디 */ , #{payrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* payroll_item_id => 급여항목아이디 */ , ccc.code_data2_value /* additional_input_value => 추가입력문자값 */ , 'A' /* pay_calc_rslt_detail_type_code => 급여산출실적상세구분코드 */ , 10 /* sort_order_no => 정렬순서번호 */ , SYSDATE /* creation_date => 생성일자 */ , #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} /* creation_user_id => 생성사용자아이디 */ FROM lgcom_common_code_c ccc WHERE ccc.code_type_code = 'LGDVHR_PAY_CLASS_TYPE_CODE' AND ccc.common_code = #{payItemClassificationCode} AND ccc.code_data2_value IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (/* PAY_VALUE가 이미 등록된건이 아닌 경우만 등록함 */ SELECT 'x' FROM tb_pay_item_detail_n pid WHERE pid.payroll_item_id = #{payrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* payroll_item_id => 급여항목아이디 */ AND pid.additional_input_value = ccc.code_data2_value )
mapper.delete: DELETE /* LGVPAY00013.deletePayrollItemDetail */ FROM tb_pay_item_detail_n WHERE payroll_item_id = #{payrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여항목아이디 */ AND payroll_item_detail_detail_id = (SELECT pid.payroll_item_detail_detail_id FROM tb_pay_item_detail_n pid WHERE pid.payroll_item_id = #{payrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여항목아이디 */ AND pid.additional_input_value = 'PAY_VALUE')
